caption.en: Two developers agree on retry behavior and a fallback for a request that times out.
caption.zh: 两位开发者讨论请求超时后的重试方式与备用处理方案。

description.en: Two developers agree on retry behavior and a fallback for a request that times out.
description.zh: 两位开发者讨论请求超时后的重试方式与备用处理方案。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What is our fallback if this request fails?
dialogue.zh: 这个请求失败时，我们的备用方案是什么？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: If there's a timeout, retry once before showing an error.
dialogue.zh: 如果发生超时，先重试一次，再显示错误。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Will the monitor keep showing the user's previous result?
dialogue.zh: 显示器上会继续显示用户之前的结果吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. Keep that result visible and offer a retry button.
dialogue.zh: 会的。保留那个结果，并提供一个重试按钮。

communication_goal: 说明重试上限与失败后的用户提示。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure developers sit at a desk. A clearly recognizable separate desktop MONITOR is on the RIGHT, front-facing, entirely visible including its rectangular screen and pedestal stand. Screen shows one large abstract result rectangle, small warning triangle, and empty outlined button, no writing. One coworker points near the monitor; the other listens with open hand. No laptop, no extra devices.
